name: process
summary: Process one starter note into deterministic structured metadata.
description: Reference app capability for downstream Traverse app authors that proves a real contract, WASM package, app manifest, workflow, and runtime request without depending on model inference. Genuinely reads the `note` input: classifies its noteType by keyword (todo/idea/meeting/question/general), derives a title from its first line or sentence, tags it (noteType plus any of urgent/blocked/needs-review/follow-up detected), suggests a next action per noteType, and derives status (completed/urgent/new) by keyword -- distinct notes produce distinct output, deterministically. This replaces the 1.0.1 fixture, which always returned the same hardcoded fields regardless of input. Built no_std on the shared agents/wasi-agent-runtime/ shim: verified to import only wasi_snapshot_preview1::{fd_read, fd_write, proc_exit}, so it is genuinely executable by Traverse's runtime, not just a generic wasmtime host. Source: agents/traverse-starter-process/ in this repo.

use_cases.scenario: As a note-taking app developer, I want to automatically classify and tag a user's freeform note by type, so that the app can route TODOs into the right list without the user manually categorizing it.

input_example.note: TODO: call the vendor about the invoice.

output_example.title: TODO: call the vendor about the invoice
output_example.suggestedNextAction: Add to the task list and assign an owner.

use_cases.scenario: As a note-taking app developer, I want the classifier to handle an empty note gracefully instead of crashing, so that a user who saves a blank note doesn't break the app's processing pipeline.

As a note-taking app developer, I want urgency keywords to drive status and tagging independently of the note's general type, so that an urgent idea or question surfaces the same way an urgent TODO would.

input_example.note: URGENT: fix the broken deploy ASAP.

output_example.title: URGENT: fix the broken deploy ASAP

preconditions.description: The caller provides a non-empty note string.

postconditions.description: The capability returns title/tags/noteType/suggestedNextAction/status fields genuinely derived from the provided note -- distinct inputs produce distinct outputs, deterministically.

side_effects.description: Produces deterministic note metadata from the provided input.
